proof_attempt_summary: D-0.5 accepted the corrected proposal at field; D0 delivered a math-reviewed pair upper and parametric lower, not a matched frontier. The normalized cyclic toy only cancels singleton curvature and its independent-neighbor ansatz fails higher-record coefficients; this does not refute all positive priors. D0.5 and independent validity consultation confirmed incremental delivery with no concrete new construction for a faithful retry; no Lean formalization was launched.
tldr: Binary causal effects are often summarized by a common conditional log-odds coefficient while confounding adjustment remains nonparametric. In the fixed low-smoothness logistic model, the covariate density is unknown and merely measurable. The target is an observable common-weight ratio with a strictly positive denominator; consistency and conditional exchangeability give its causal interpretation almost everywhere. Common-root algebra, the generic ambient-mixture length transfer and the Bernoulli floor are credited prerequisites. A pair construction supplies a provisional simultaneous honest upper bound. The field-tier novel kernel is the complete expected-length frontier under ambient finite-sample honesty, including the null and all shrinking effect radii, attained by one computable interval sequence. Selective normalized likelihood comparison is the principal construction handle; a stronger common-root correction remains an admissible resolution. No candidate radius power or design penalty is assumed.
gap: Published density-free higher-order and rough-design variance results leave the original-record honest-length frontier for a homogeneous binary logistic effect unresolved. Their rank regimes or common-variance restrictions do not provide the needed model-specific transfer.
fill: Open-ended Question 6 requires an explicit matched profile and one total interval for every evaluation radius, with legal normalized fixed-size comparisons or a stronger design-eliminating construction inside the stated model. The observable target and its positive denominator, generic mixture-length transfer and parametric floor are credited supporting prerequisites; the unknown merely measurable-design frontier is the field-tier novel contribution.
